When the user selects a problem on the App, the holds that make up that problem are illuminated by their corresponding LED lights.


Our new LED system gives users access to tens of thousands of MoonBoard problems in just a click and a swipe, making the MoonBoard training facility even more user-friendly and accessible than ever before.
